answer: Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The gale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the walnut. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable.
